paragraphs: Coach Matt's Story, posted by Lily. The Explorers are writing about people for a club project. I chose Coach Matt, because he teaches sport at our school. On Tuesday, he told me his story after football practice. Here it is in short. His lessons are fun, and the children like him.

Matt was born in a small town near the sea. At seven, he got a football from his uncle. He played with it in the street every day. He was not big, but he ran very fast. At ten, he joined a school team. His boots were cheap, and they were too big. He wore two pairs of socks to make them fit. One boot had a small hole, but he wore it anyway.

At twelve, Matt played his first big match. It was an awful day. His team lost by seven goals to nothing. Matt went home and said to his mother, "I want to practice more." His mother watched him from the window. Every evening, he did his training in the street. He kicked the ball against a wall for an hour. After one year, he was a much better player. His friends came to the street to play with him.

At twenty, Matt joined a small team in his town. A local magazine wrote a short story about the team. It had a photo of Matt with his cheap old boots. Matt laughed when he saw it. He still has the page in a box at home. "I was lucky," he said, "but luck needs practice." At twenty-two, he became a sport teacher.

Matt started his own team for children at twenty-five. The children played on Sunday mornings in a park. Then our school asked him to be the coach. He said yes immediately. He loves his job, and he is always on time. He has been our coach for six years. Coach Matt always says, "Do not be afraid of a bad match." We are lucky to have him. Which sport do you like? Tell us in a message!
